name: Розвиток фігур (4)
description:
In the initial position, your pieces are passive. By developing the pieces towards more active squares, they can start to work together to attack enemy targets. In this lesson, a specific developing move is always significantly better than all alternatives.

What do you have to do?

Find the most optimal developing move. Sometimes this is castling.

examples.text: Білі взяли багато місця. Зараз важливо добре захистити центр.
Усі білі фігури розроблені. Тепер настав час і замку. Ми обираємо коротку чи довгу рокіровку? Обидва варіанти хороші, але найкращий тут 1.0-0-0! Щоб білі могли атакувати на королівському фланзі.

texts: Це розвиває фігуру з темпом.
Розробіть фігури з темпом, якщо це можливо.
This frees the rook and defends the knight.
Try to activate your inactive pieces and ensure everything is defended.
The king is safest on the kingside and the rook is active here.
Complete development. Consider where your king is best placed.
puzzles.text: A tough choice: long or short? In this case, castling long is less favorable. The king isn't safe on c1, as Black's bishop controls key squares. Moreover, White's rook on d1 doesn't yet pose a strong discovered attack.

texts: The king is safe, the knight is unpinned, and the rook is active.
Повний розвиток.
король безпечний, а тури можна з’єднати.
Повний розвиток.
White defends the knight while developing a piece.
Activate your pieces and defend the knight.
White castles and activates the bishop.
Choose aggressive development.
puzzles.text: Since White has a lead in development, the king is safe on the queenside. Moreover, Black has immediate issues with the knight on d4. Black can only defend this piece with ...e5. But that leaves a huge hole on d5 where the White knight can jump.

texts: Black wants to castle quickly, without White giving an annoying check on e1.
The bishop is unpinned and the king is safe.
Activate inactive pieces and castle ASAP.
Повний розвиток.
This castles and activates the rook on a nice open file.
Повний розвиток.
The bishop is beautifully placed on the long diagonal.
Play your pieces to active squares and prevent White's threats.
puzzles.text: Watch the opponent's threats. On other moves, White has strong Qf3!

texts: The king is safe and the pawns are defended.
Повний розвиток.
The knight is defended and White now threatens dangerous discovered attacks.
Develop pieces and create threats.
